title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README to understand the Crypto Screener Pro platform: real-time market data from 9 exchanges, TradingView-style charts, pattern detection, liquidity heatmap, and Telegram Mini App support.

title: Monorepo Structure
description: The project is a Turborepo monorepo with two apps (apps/api, apps/web) and two packages (packages/shared, packages/exchange-connectors). Turbo orchestrates parallel build and dev tasks.

title: Shared Type Contracts
description: The @crypto-screener/shared package defines all cross-cutting types: ExchangeId (9 exchanges), Ticker, Candle, Timeframe, OrderBook, and Trade. Both API and frontend import from here.

title: Exchange Connectors
description: The @crypto-screener/exchange-connectors package provides WebSocket connectors for 9 exchanges. BaseExchangeConnector defines the interface; ExchangeManager orchestrates them, aggregating events.

title: NestJS API Bootstrap
description: The API starts at main.ts which bootstraps NestJS with security middleware (Helmet, rate limiting), WebSocket adapter, and Swagger docs. AppModule imports all 8 feature modules.

title: Real-Time Market Data Pipeline
description: MarketService connects to ExchangeManager on startup, subscribes to tickers/candles for top 20 symbols, throttles broadcasts (100ms), and stores closed candles to PostgreSQL. MarketGateway manages per-client WebSocket subscriptions.

title: Pattern Detection System
description: The pattern scanner runs on a schedule, fetching candles and running 4 detectors: Breakout, Retest, LiquiditySweep, StructureBreak. Each uses detector.utils for ATR/pivot calculations. Results are scored by pattern-actionability and cached in Redis.

title: Frontend State Management
description: The frontend uses Zustand for global state: MarketStore (live tickers/candles), DrawingStore (chart annotations with cross-tab sync via BroadcastChannel), UIStore (view modes, alerts), and OrderbookStore.

title: WebSocket Client & Real-Time Updates
description: useWebSocket hook manages the client-side WebSocket connection with auto-reconnect. On messages, it dispatches to Zustand stores. useSignalMonitor watches tickers against signal-level drawings and fires alerts.

title: Chart Drawing Engine
description: The drawing engine converts drawing models to SVG coordinates using chart projection APIs. DrawingOverlay renders an interactive SVG on the chart. DrawingSyncBus propagates operations across tabs. Drawings persist to localStorage.

title: ChartCard: The Core Chart Component
description: ChartCard is the most complex frontend component: it initializes Lightweight Charts, handles real-time candle updates, lazy-loads historical candles on scroll-back, overlays heatmap data, and embeds the drawing overlay and toolbar.

title: Patterns Dashboard
description: The patterns view combines a filterable list (PatternsList + PatternsFilters) with a detail pane (PatternDetailsCard) showing an embedded chart with pattern overlay. usePatternsQuery fetches from the API with polling.

title: Infrastructure & Deployment
description: The project deploys to Railway (API + web) or VPS (Docker Compose + nginx). CI/CD via GitHub Actions. Three Dockerfiles: root, API-specific, and web-specific. Supervisord runs multiple processes in a single container.
